title: RunResult
description: Result of one sandboxed test run, as reported by a runner container.

status.description: ok: the test command ran to completion (tests may still have failed). timeout: killed at the time limit. oom: killed for exceeding the memory limit. error: tests could not be collected or run, or the test command crashed.

reason.description: Why status is error, when the backend knows. test_set_mismatch: the collected test ids differed from the task's expected ids, so no test counts as passed. Null otherwise.

stdout_tail.description: Last part of stdout, truncated by the runner.

stderr_tail.description: Last part of stderr, truncated by the runner.

id.description: Runner test id, e.g. a pytest node id.

message.description: Failure or error message. Null when the test passed.

Summary.description: failed counts both failed and error outcomes; total also counts skipped tests.
